        q = deque()
        for i in range(chip[0], chip[1] + 1):

                if 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n and mat[i, j]:
                    visited[i, j] = True
                    q.append((i, j))
        while q:
            x, y = q.popleft()
            for dx, dy in [(1,0), (-1,0), (0,1), (0,-1)]:
                nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
                if 0 <= nx < n and 0 <= ny < n and mat[nx, ny] and not visited[nx, ny]:
                    visited[nx, ny] = True
                    q.append((nx, ny))
        mat &= visited
